description: This Java source file defines the EventVariable class, representing a specific event derived from an XML schema for use within a generating service variable framework. It extends CustomVariable and provides methods for JSON representation, type adjustment, and native adapter initialization string generation.

classes.name: EventVariable
classes.description: Represents a defined Event from the XML, extending CustomVariable, with methods for JSON output, type naming, and adapter string generation.

methods.name: EventVariable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EventVariable with an ICEvent bean and sets its parent class name to 'BaseEvent'.

methods.name: isEvent
methods.description: Returns true, indicating this variable represents an event.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java type name for this event variable, ensuring it ends with 'Event'.

methods.name: getAdapterNativeInitString
methods.description: Generates a string for native C adapter initialization code, recursively initializing nested event variables and custom variables within this event.
